dedupe_keys.name: machine learning aided voltage stability constrained optimal power flow dataset and source code

description: Machine Learning-Aided Voltage Stability-Constrained Optimal Power Flow Dataset and Source Code is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Abdelwahab Bebars, Muhammad Ragab Hammad (University of Nevada, Reno). This repository contains the dataset and source code developed for machine learning-aided voltage stability-constrained optimal power flow (ML-VSCOPF) studies on a modified IEEE 118-bus power system. The dataset contains operating conditions, network topology information, renewable-generation dispatch, load conditions, and voltage-stability-margin labels used to train and evaluate machine learning models for estimating voltage stability margins. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
